text: {"lessons":["My account has moved through both declines and strong gains, so I should avoid reacting to short-term swings and stay focused on my long-term plan.","Stock D has risen far above my average cost, and trimming it in stages can help manage concentration without requiring me to guess the peak.","I should review my allocation periodically and make deliberate trades based on diversification, risk, and the investment case—not just recent performance or a gain versus my cost."]}
